goal: Draw one outline for every colony, on the colony's outer edge. Touching colonies are separate colonies: a mass of three touching colonies is three colonies, each with its own outline. Some plates show part of a dish: measure every colony in view, including colonies cut by the edge.

concepts.title: A mass of three touching colonies
concepts.caption: Measure three colonies, each with its own outline. One outline around the whole mass counts one colony of the wrong size.

concepts.title: Two touching colonies
concepts.caption: Two colonies, two outlines, even where they overlap deeply.

concepts.title: Where the edge is
concepts.caption: A colony's outline follows its outer edge, including the pale margin around the dark center.
